name: Adaptive Subdivision in DiffTetVR
definition: A training strategy that refines the tetrahedral mesh by subdividing vertices with high color gradients to increase resolution where needed, aiming to solve the issue of wasted resolution in empty regions.
summary: Adaptive Subdivision in DiffTetVR is a coarse-to-fine training strategy that refines tetrahedral meshes by locally subdividing vertices with high color gradients, differing from other methods by using gradient-based selection and prism splitting on tetrahedral topology.
